name: Stormsinger Cloak

effects.name: Resistance
effects.tooltip: Resistance +5 : Passive: +5 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

effects.name: Perform
effects.tooltip: Perform +14 : Passive: +14 Competence bonus to the Perform skill.

effects.name: Sonic Guard
effects.tooltip: Sonic Guard : This item blasts those that attack the wearer, causing 1d6 sonic damage on a successful melee attack.

effects.name: Anthem
effects.tooltip: Anthem : When equipped by a character with Bard levels, this item begins to hum an inspiring tune. Your bard songs regenerate slowly over time.

flavor_text: Some harpies of the Stormsinger flight wear cloaks such as this to increase their musical prowess. It will also protect the wearer with violent sonic energy.

source.detail: Captain Markus ' chest and optional chests
source.raw: Assault on Summerfield , Captain Markus ' chest and optional chests
